- Load wizard content through the category index instead of scanning unrelated library records, and load tools alongside the required categories.
- Read item keys once and fetch bounded batches for tool selection, avoiding one cursor round trip per item while retaining only tools.
- Reuse validated spell memberships across wizard UI checks while respecting current source filters.
- Validation: All 60 targeted content-cache, wizard and tool-selection checks passed. A synthetic 9,100-record IndexedDB comparison reduced the library-loading phase from 1,607 ms to 43 ms; this is not a measurement of total wizard opening time on a mobile device.
